title: Tötungsdelikt am Humboldt Forum – letzter Tatverdächtiger festgenommen

extraction.summaryEn: A 20-year-old man died after a group fight at the Humboldt Forum on 12 September 2025, which the 6th Homicide Unit is investigating. The last suspect, a 16-year-old, was arrested in Gesundbrunnen on 21 May 2026 and placed in youth detention.
